body:
## Problem
Recovery evidence must be refreshed during launch week and after storage/save changes.

## Player impact
Stale recovery evidence risks unrecoverable progress loss.

## Scope
Capture Supabase plus remote overlay; restore to distinct isolated targets; verify hashes, counts, representative records, RPO/RTO, and cleanup.

## Explicit exclusions
No production overwrite, destructive schema rollback, or ordinary-player mutation.

## Relevant files
docs/BACKUP_RESTORE_RUNBOOK.md; scripts/kv-backup.mjs; api/admin/save-snapshot.ts

## Acceptance criteria
Different target identity; guards work; hashes/counts and representative saves/clans/images/receipts match; health passes.

## Required tests
Backup tests, same-target/nonempty refusal, checksum, save-lock restore.

## Feature flags
Disable scheduled jobs on isolated targets; one production snapshot primary.

## Rollback approach
Delete isolated targets and temporary credentials.

**Priority: P1**
title: [P1] Repeat the hybrid save backup and isolated restore drill

## Problem
Creator story/event rewards, Hollow Gate linkage, live retries, and receipt search remain incomplete.

## Player impact
A missed path can forge, replay, duplicate, or strand valuable rewards.

## Scope
Maintain reward-path inventory; close gaps with server calculation, account/event/completion binding, once receipts, atomic deduction, retry recovery, and admin search.

## Explicit exclusions
No global rewrite, balance changes, new currencies, or enabling gated systems.

## Relevant files
RELEASE_REWARD_INTEGRITY_AUDIT.md; receipt helpers; mission/story/event/Hollow Gate/creator settlements

## Acceptance criteria
Every valuable path classified/flagged; unsafe closed; client amounts ignored; deductions/grants once and recoverable; receipts searchable.

## Required tests
Duplicate/concurrent, wrong account/event, expired token, forged amount, partial failure, retry, admin lookup.

## Feature flags
Keep unsafe boss/mission/AI/creator/event flags disabled.

## Rollback approach
Disable feature; freeze rewards during exploit; retain/reconcile receipts.

**Priority: P1**
title: [P1] Close remaining reward-integrity and receipt gaps

## Problem
The complete two-role staging and unauthorized-player matrices are not current.

## Player impact
Operators may be unable to stop abuse, inspect receipts, or correct incidents.

## Scope
Test Admin 1/2 login, search/save, ban/silence/kick, linked accounts, message removal, audits, economy/reward/battle receipts, ranked/Legacy, snapshots, dangerous auth.

## Explicit exclusions
No auth weakening, production editing, dashboard redesign, or unnecessary IP export.

## Relevant files
api/admin/*; api/admin-auth.ts; ADMIN_RELEASE_AUDIT.md; docs/BETA_LIVE_OPERATIONS.md

## Acceptance criteria
Role policy matches; ordinary players fail all admin/maker/economy/correction/save/image/approval routes; dangerous actions audited.

## Required tests
Two-role positive, player negative, wrong/expired credentials, rate limits, audit fields, correction idempotency.

## Feature flags
Creator/image/war/boss controls remain disabled unless staffed.

## Rollback approach
Rotate secrets/revoke sessions/disable feature; retain audit evidence.

**Priority: P1**
title: [P1] Certify admin and moderation operations with two roles

## Problem
Creator/AI paths can introduce impossible effects, premium rewards, unsafe content, or spend.

## Player impact
Unsafe content damages fairness, economy, safety, and cost.

## Scope
Verify caps, admin-only rewards/items, approval bypass defense, cost/rates, upload validation, disable-without-save-loss, logs, rollback.

## Explicit exclusions
No public enablement, UI redesign, marketplace, or AI promotion.

## Relevant files
CREATED_CONTENT_BETA_AUDIT.md; api/generate-image.ts; api/images.ts; maker/review/admin endpoints

## Acceptance criteria
No premium/admin/impossible player creations; unsafe content removable/disableable; uploads/rates/cost bounded; decisions logged; players cannot access admin maker.

## Required tests
Forged stats/effects/rewards, bypass, rate/cost, MIME/size/polyglot, disabled-save compatibility, rollback.

## Feature flags
Keep ENABLE_PLAYER_AI_IMAGE_GENERATION unset and creators gated.

## Rollback approach
Disable content/feature without deleting saves; preserve audit.

**Priority: P1**
title: [P1] Certify creator and AI moderation readiness

body:
## Problem
Clan Boss is server-authoritative structurally but lacks full party/retry/expiry/weekly staging evidence.

## Player impact
Failures can lose items, duplicate clan damage/rewards, or credit the wrong clan.

## Scope
Run solo/party matrix with stored boss, all action/item classes, phases, win/wipe/timeout, resume, attempt caps, standings, and weekly payout.

## Explicit exclusions
No UI redesign, combat rewrite, balance tuning, or production clan mutation.

## Relevant files
api/clan-boss/*; api/towers/*; api/cron/_clan-boss-weekly.ts; COMBAT_PARITY_AUDIT.md

## Acceptance criteria
Server-derived damage only; duplicate settle banks once; wrong clan/player fails; items deduct once; expiry/caps/standings/weekly payout pass.

## Required tests
Solo/party, wrong clan/player, duplicate/concurrent settle, expiry, reconnect, every action/item, weekly rerun.

## Feature flags
ENABLE_CLAN_BOSS=1 only in safe staging; use DISABLE_CLAN_BOSS=1 until accepted.

## Rollback approach
Disable Clan Boss; retain assaults/receipts for reconciliation.

**Priority: P1**
title: [P1] Complete Clan Boss staging certification

body:
## Problem
Topology validation passes, but configured health, rollback execution, job ownership, cache, and live latency evidence remain open.

## Player impact
Wrong store/cron/cache/rollback can lose saves or duplicate work despite a green build.

## Scope
Run all release gates, deep health expected store/commit/backup, cache checks, one-primary proof, login/first-save latency, reconnect, and disposable rollback/forward verification.

## Explicit exclusions
No broad performance refactor, Redis, heartbeat replacement, replica increase, or UI work.

## Relevant files
railway.json; Dockerfile; check-deployment-config.mjs; release-health-check.mjs; runbooks

## Acceptance criteria
One replica; correct commit/store/fresh backup; health/cache/jobs pass; rollback executes; newer save remains compatible.

## Required tests
Root/client gates, mission eligibility, assets, size, topology, rollback readiness, health, save/reward retry.

## Feature flags
Record all active flags and match launch recommendation.

## Rollback approach
Rollback retained image with freeze; keep additive schema; verify health/save/receipts/reconnect.

**Priority: P1**
title: [P1] Complete deployment and release-health certification

## Problem
War defaults on at startup unless disabled, while simultaneous settlement and event evidence are incomplete.

## Player impact
Unstaffed war can duplicate rewards/territory or skew a low-population world.

## Scope
Use docs/CONTROLLED_WAR_EVENT_RUNBOOK.md with bounded eligibility/time, staff, snapshots, caps, authority checks, correction, rollback, disputes, and report.

## Explicit exclusions
No permanent season, UI redesign, or speculative balance/economy change.

## Relevant files
api/village/sector-war.ts; api/_sector-war*.ts; war helpers; launch controls

## Acceptance criteria
Only complete PvP resolves one contest; wrong/replay rejects; territory/rewards/economy once-only; corrections audited; low participation non-destructive.

## Required tests
Duplicate/concurrent, wrong player/sector, one battle/two contests, retry, atomic ownership, correction, kill switch.

## Feature flags
Set DISABLE_VILLAGE_WAR=1 outside staffed windows; record Railway state.

## Rollback approach
Disable war; freeze rewards if needed; audited correction/restore.

**Priority: P1**
title: [P1] Run one controlled staffed Village/Sector War event
